items.summary:
Found during lead review of PR #1142 (#1118), merged as `c73ed124`. Pre-existing, not
introduced by that PR, which is why I filed rather than held it.

`AbbreviationTooltip` composes its accessible name as `` `${label}: ${definition}` ``
(`src/components/common/AbbreviationTooltip.jsx`), so a `STAT_DEFINITIONS` entry whose
definition *restates its own term* gets that term announced twice.
